items.description: Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver with local connection for AAP; covers both lb:false and lb:true scenarios for NGINX OSS on OpenShift
Molecule converge playbook — creates expected filesystem state under /tmp/molecule_test/; exercises provision role with lb:false and lb:true scenarios; sets namespace, server, lb_method variables
items.notes: Creates /tmp/molecule_test/ directory scaffold with all role structural files (tasks, defaults, templates, meta, collections, EE files). Renders default.conf.j2 for 6 scenarios: lb=false, lb=true/least_conn, lb=true/hash, lb=true/ip_hash, lb=true/round_robin, lb=string-false (APB survey guard).

items.description: Molecule no-op instance destroy playbook — delegated driver requires explicit create/destroy stubs
Molecule no-op instance create playbook — delegated driver requires explicit create/destroy stubs
Molecule verify playbook — checks /tmp/molecule_test/ paths; validates rendered NGINX config for lb:false and lb:true; confirms lb|bool filter, server_list rename, lb_method default guard are applied
items.notes: 5 sections: (1) structural file existence checks via stat+assert; (2) file content checks via slurp+assert (no legacy modules, kubernetes.core.k8s present, template lookup used, defaults correct, argument_specs has required:true for namespace, collections/requirements.yml references kubernetes.core, requirements.txt has kubernetes/openshift/PyYAML, EE yml uses modern format); (3) rendered config assertions for all 6 template scenarios; (4) template source modernization checks (lb|bool, server_list, default guards); (5) cluster/service checks tagged molecule-notest.
